async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Locate the search bar (searchbox) on the page
    # Try to find a searchbox role
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search", exact=False)
    if await searchbox.count() == 0:
        # If not found, try to find a search role and then searchbox within it
        search = page.get_by_role("search")
        if await search.count() > 0:
            searchbox = search.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search", exact=False)
        else:
            # Fallback: look for any text input that might be a search bar
            searchbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search", exact=False)
    
    # Fill the searchbox with 'playbook'
    await searchbox.first.fill("playbook")
    
    # Step 2: Find and click the search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search", exact=False)
    if await search_button.count() == 0:
        # If no button with name 'Search', try to find within search role
        search_button = page.get_by_role("search").get_by_role("button", name="Search", exact=False)
    await search_button.first.click()
    
    # Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Identify search result links
    # Assume results are links under the main content or in a list
    result_links = page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("link")
    result_count = await result_links.count()
    
    if result_count >= 2:
        # Click the second-to-last link (index count-2)
        second_to_last_link = result_links.nth(result_count - 2)
        await second_to_last_link.click()
    else:
        # If not enough links in main, try all links on the page
        all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
        all_count = await all_links.count()
        if all_count >= 2:
            second_to_last_all = all_links.nth(all_count - 2)
            await second_to_last_all.click()
        else:
            # If only one or no links, click the first available link
            await result_links.first.click()
    
    # After clicking, the task is complete
    return
